args.query:
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT * 
FROM measurements
WHERE value NOT IN 
(SELECT value 
FROM measurements
WHERE value > (SELECT AVG(value) + 2 * STDDEV(value) FROM measurements) 
OR value < (SELECT AVG(value) - 2 * STDDEV(value) FROM measurements));
